subject.title: fix(llm): summarize ephemeral tool results to preserve prefix cache

question: Should OpenClaw pursue fixed placeholder summaries for any tool results in this PR, and if so which tool-result classes are allowed to hide their content from the model?
rationale: The cache problem is real, but hiding general-purpose tool outputs changes agent reasoning semantics and needs an owner decision rather than a broad hard-coded tool-name list.

options.title: Require redesign before merge
options.body: Keep semantic tool outputs visible, restrict any placeholder policy to clearly non-semantic status/no-op results, and require real DeepSeek proof after the rework.

options.title: Narrow to status-only summaries
options.body: Allow a smaller branch for heartbeat/status acknowledgments only while leaving exec/read/web/memory/mcporter untouched.

options.title: Pause this PR
options.body: Leave the linked issue open for a broader cache-safe tool-result policy if maintainers do not want fixed summaries in provider conversion.

recommendation.title: Require redesign before merge
recommendation.body: Keep semantic tool outputs visible, restrict any placeholder policy to clearly non-semantic status/no-op results, and require real DeepSeek proof after the rework.

likelyOwner.reason: Vincent has the strongest current-main history signal for the provider and prompt-cache paths involved.
